params.body:
Why #192 broke every photo on staging: outside production the vehicles disk is wrapped in DemoMediaDisk, which reads from demo/ first (the seal writes everything there, so the derived sizes live under vehicles/demo/_afgeleid/...). The SDK path went through that wrapper; the presigner built the key from the raw path and signed a file that is not there: 404 (Shane's tinker comparison: host same, signature valid, path differs by demo/). Now the presigner asks the wrapper where the file lives (DemoMediaDisk::resolve) before signing. On production there is no wrapper and no demo/.

Stays behind OWN_PRESIGNER (off by default, #195). To try it on staging: OWN_PRESIGNER=true in .env, config:clear; the same tinker snippet should then print sdk 200 / own 200 and path same.
params.title: Own presigner: go through DemoMediaDisk for the real path
